purpose: Author KIBER PORTAL robot_card, compilation, and article_detail content via Hermes-led SEO research, Wordstat/SERP analysis, competitor gap analysis, Cyber Gosha style, and structured page-block content packages.

researchStages.description: Define page type, target slug, audience, conversion goal, source documents, and claims requiring source status.
Collect/record Yandex Wordstat query volumes or mark needs_wordstat_verification honestly.
Inspect search results for target queries and record competitors, page types, strengths, weak spots, and content gaps.
Translate competitor weaknesses into KIBER content angle without mocking/copying competitors.
Prepare title, description, H1, canonical, primary/secondary/long-tail keywords, schema types, AI summary.
Map every public text item to approved blocks before writing prose.
Apply correct Kiber Gosha dosage per page type and stop-phrase bans.
Verify price/capability/media/legal claims and split actualDescription from seoAlt.
Produce reviewable internal links with target, anchor, reason, and status.
Run validators/build/preview checks before owner review.

wordstatAccessPolicy.captcha2faPolicy: Stop and ask for human action; never bypass captcha or 2FA.

sourceMaterialPolicy.oldClaudeTexts: Allowed as source/information base, not as final copy authority.
sourceMaterialPolicy.robotCardTexts: Allowed as factual source if source status is recorded.
sourceMaterialPolicy.articlesAndCompilations: Allowed for analysis, structure, gaps, and reusable facts; must be rewritten into approved block packages.

ownerInputsNeeded: historical Claude-written articles/compilations/robot card texts as source corpus
approval for first pilot page type and slug
